name: app-shater-craftsman-portrait-with-phone-and-toast-notifications
title: Craftsman holding a phone and hard hat, beside two dark toast notification mockups and portrait photos
whatItIs: A collage: a close crop of a craftsman in a flannel shirt holding both a phone and a yellow hard hat, a dark lock-screen phone showing two toast notifications ('New offer arrived!', 'Service in progress!'), and two more portrait photos of craftsmen each beside phone screens.
whatItMeans: Human and immediate; showing the notification on a lock screen makes the app's real-time updates feel tangible.
techniques: Mock a notification on a realistic lock screen.
Pair each persona photo with their relevant screens.
Crop photos tightly for an intimate, documentary feel.

vocabulary.definition: A brief pop-up message that appears and fades.
A phone's screen before it is unlocked.
